entities.summary: The Polish Initiative was a progressive political party in Poland. It was formed as an association in 2016, and was registered as a political party in 2019. Its leader was Barbara Nowacka, and it was part of the Civic Coalition. It supported principles of social liberalism, social democracy and secularism. It was described as right-wing, centre-right, centrist, centre-left or left-wing.
